tier_meaning: Pup — live and useful, not yet validated. It may compute real answers and still have open questions about calibration, assumptions, data quality or edge. Everything starts here.
source: Sleeper weekly NFL player projections; league-scored in the browser
note: Daily snapshot. Player timestamps are source update times. Projections are not live scores. Historical uncertainty is descriptive, not prospectively validated.

calibration.method: Historical residual RMS by position and projected-score bucket, shrunk with 40 position observations; nonnegative same-team common factor capped at 0.25. Normal residuals. No fitted injury probability.
calibration.limitation: Historical Sleeper projections can be revised after games. These are descriptive uncertainty estimates, not out-of-sample calibration. Correlation between opposing NFL teams and negative teammate correlations are not modeled.
